invoices.note: Accepting a quote issues its invoice, due in {days} days; it falls overdue when the date passes unpaid, and is voided if the order is cancelled first. Mark paid once the transfer is matched; that is what moves the order into packing. An invoice freezes the order's line prices at issue time. The PDF is the preview itself, captured at A4; what you approve on screen is what the client receives.
invoices.frozen: This invoice is issued. Its lines and amounts are frozen; a change after issue is a credit note.
invoices.notes_hint: A blank line starts a new paragraph. {token} becomes the net days.
invoices.credit_hint: Applies against this invoice. PPN follows the invoice rate.

document.default_notes:
Bank transfer to the account above, with {token} as the reference, within {days} days of issue. Goods travel cold chain at 2–8 °C where the lot requires it. Each lot travels with its Certificate of Analysis; retain it with this document.

Opened lots are not returnable. Report any discrepancy in writing within 7 days of delivery.
document.quote_notes: Prices as listed on the date of issue, frozen for the validity of this quotation. Payment by bank transfer before dispatch. Delivery is charged per destination.
document.quote_ppn_note: PPN at {rate}% is applied when this quotation is accepted and its invoice is issued, payable within {days} days of issue.

flow.title: Flow map
flow.heading: How an order moves
flow.lead: One direction, one record per step. Every list, chip and notification in the app is derived from where each record sits on this line.
flow.s1_t: The account picks lines from the catalogue, or repeats a past order. Nothing is priced or held yet.
flow.s1_b: or the console starts a quote itself → draft
flow.s2_t: Priced from the list, one delivery charge per destination, sent as an itemised IDR message on WhatsApp. Sending reserves the stock.
flow.s2_b: every line must be available and every destination priced, or Send stays off · valid {days} days, then expired · lost releases the stock
flow.s3_t: One action. The order is created with lines, prices, addresses and delivery frozen exactly as quoted.
flow.s3_b: a later price change never touches an accepted order
flow.s4_t: Issued at acceptance, due in {days} days, bank transfer with the invoice number as reference.
flow.s4_b: cancel before dispatch voids it · a change after issue is a credit note
flow.s5_t: The account reports the transfer; the console matches it to the bank and marks paid, recording who, when and the reference.
flow.s5_b: payment is the only door into packing · overdue is derived from the due date, never typed
flow.s6_t: Cold-chain lines close at {cold}, ambient at {ambient}. Packed before the cut-off leaves today; after it, tomorrow.
flow.s6_b: the Today feed counts down to the cut-off
flow.s7_t: Marking dispatched writes the sale to the stock ledger and lifts the reservation.
flow.s7_b: estimated delivery is dispatch plus the zone's transit days
flow.s8_t: Closes the order and sets the account's next reorder from its cadence.
flow.s8_b: reorder due within seven days appears on Today · a reorder starts a new quote request
